sections.title: Above the fold
sections.guide: One headline: the service and the city, exactly as the ads say it. Under it the offer in one line and the phone as a tap-to-call button.
sections.example: Service in Your City — free estimate. Call (555) 555-0100.

sections.title: Why this business
sections.guide: A few short reasons taken from the business's own facts: years in business, what makes it different, real reviews with the reviewer's first name and the source; never a review the business did not receive.

sections.title: What to expect
sections.guide: A few plain sentences on the service: what happens, how long it takes, and the price or that the estimate is free. No promises about results.
sections.example: Call and we'll walk you through the next step and the price before anything starts.

sections.title: Request a call
sections.guide: Name, phone, the service, and a ZIP code. One line under the button saying when the business calls back.
sections.example: We call back within one business day.

sections.title: Questions people ask
sections.guide: Four to six questions with one-paragraph answers: the price, how the service works, timing, and the service area.
sections.example: What does it cost? It depends on the job; call for a free estimate.

sections.title: Hours and where
sections.guide: Opening hours, the address or service area with a map link, the phone again.

sections.title: Footer
sections.guide: The business's name, a Terms link and the Privacy notice link (the privacy link is required when the page has a form), and the business's phone or e-mail.

form_rules: Say when the business calls back.
